quick_skim.title: A Simple and Extremely Efficient Predictive Control for Power Converters
quick_skim.abstract: Classical finite control set based model predictive control (FCS-MPC) reduces the optimal problems to an enumerated searching algorithm, which is very simple and effective to control power converters. However, it requires a large amount of enumeration operations, increasing its computational load and hardware costs. In this work, we propose a new and simple predictive control technique with extreme efficiency. The proposal directly selects the optimal vector via determined visual maps, abstained solely requiring a rearrangement of the cost function and a simple fitting law, without any enumeration. It has been validated under a lab-constructed power converter and a set of commercialized low-cost digital controllers. Experimental data confirm that the proposal achieves the same control performance as classical MPC, with significant computational burden reduction (up to 88\% for one-step prediction of two-level converters)

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对传统有限集模型预测控制枚举计算量大的问题，论文提出一种基于可视化映射直接选择最优矢量的极高效预测控制方法，无需枚举即可完成优化。该方法仅需对代价函数重排并配合简单拟合规则，大幅降低计算开销。在实验室功率变换器与商用低成本数字控制器上的实验验证了其有效性与高效率。该方法为DAB等电力变换器的实时效率优化提供了可行的控制途径。

quick_skim.title: Event-Driven Simulation of Power Electronics Rich Grid Models
quick_skim.abstract: Power-electronics systems should be treated according to their natural mathematical structure---inherent switching and discontinuities with piecewise continuous states. Therefore, the simulator should be organized around events, switching topologies, and topology intervals, rather than only around a continuous-time solver that later corrects or smooths discontinuities. This paper presents a simple, event-driven EMT architecture using native C kernels with Python orchestration. With this method, we distill the essential elements of discrete-event simulation applied to power electronics problems and thereby point toward a broad research thrust wherein mature ideas from discrete-event simulation are adapted for use in simulating power electronics circuits.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Presents an event-driven EMT simulation architecture for power electronics systems, organizing simulation around switching events and topology intervals to handle discontinuities naturally.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对电力电子系统固有的开关与分段连续特性，论文提出一种以事件为中心、由原生C内核与Python编排的电磁暂态仿真架构。通过围绕开关事件和拓扑区间组织仿真，而非依赖连续时间求解器修正不连续，该方法更自然地表征变换器行为。在相关算例中验证了架构的有效性，并为将离散事件仿真思想应用于电力电子电路仿真指出了研究前景。该方案有望用于DAB等变换器的高效设计与优化。
